title: Simple Gens
description: Minecraft simple generator plugin, built for instant or timed block regeneration, with build in broadcast messages. Required WorldEdit or FAWE to work.
body:
# SimpleGens
High-performance, fully customizable interactive generator management for modern networks.


## Overview
SimpleGens is a robust, lightweight generator plugin designed from the ground up for stability and performance. Built specifically to eliminate the lag spikes common in large-scale survival and skyblock economies, it utilizes asynchronous processing and partitioned block regeneration. Administrators can completely customize, create, and manage generators in real-time through an intuitive, comprehensive GUI.


## Core Features
* **Performance-First Architecture:** Features partitioned block regeneration and asynchronous processing to maintain steady TPS, even on high-population servers.
* **In-Game GUI Editors:** Create and modify generators entirely in-game. Includes interactive icon selection and real-time timer adjustment menus.
* **Visual Boundary Particle Borders:** Displays clear, real-time particle borders around generator zones to help players visualize operational boundaries.
* **Exploit Prevention & Safety:** Built-in anti-exploit logic blocks Fortune enchantment abuse, prevents illegal block placement, and stops mining when a player's inventory is full.
* **Smart Reset Handler:** Automatically detects players within the regeneration zone and safely elevates or moves them to prevent glitches or suffocations during resets.
* **Rich Text Customization:** Full MiniMessage support for modern, vibrant chat and broadcast formatting.
* **Complete Localization:** Every user-facing string, menu item, and broadcast is completely configurable via an external `messages.yml` file.


## Commands & Permissions

* `/gens gui` - Opens the main generator management interface.
  * Permission: `simplegens.gens.gui`
* `/gens create <name>` - Initializes a new generator template.
  * Permission: `simplegens.gens.create`
* `/gens particles` - Toggles the visibility of visual boundary borders.
  * Permission: `simplegens.particle`
